name: Intercom
description: Inter-session communication and presence. Lets any session see what other sessions are doing (live roster with derived liveness, plus deep inspection of a peer's tasks, background jobs, and sub-agent fleet) and message them (note, ping, interrupt, or broadcast). Messages are durable, pull-delivered as a per-turn <ma::agent::intercom-inbox> block, and crash/resume safe. Ping/interrupt wake an idle peer between turns. Tools: IntercomPeers, IntercomSend, IntercomInbox. Disable presence with MINIMAL_AGENT_INTERCOM_NO_PRESENCE=1.

tool.name: Peers
tool.description: List the other minimal-agent sessions on this machine, or inspect one peer in depth. Use it before you message a peer, or when you must know what a peer is doing. Do not use it to reach a sub-agent worker: use Mailbox. Returns the roster with short id, liveness, model, directory and activity, or one peer bundle for `inspect`.

action.description: "list" (default) for the roster, or "inspect" for one peer. Liveness: online beating, busy in a turn, stale not beating, hung process alive, dead process gone, offline exited cleanly.

peer.description: inspect: which peer to look at. A short id (e.g. "a1b2c3d4"), a full session id, or an at-mention. Required for inspect.

include.description: inspect: which sections to gather. Default [tasks, activity, jobs]. Add "fleet" for sub-agents, "transcript" for a recent transcript excerpt.

liveOnly.description: list: drop dead/offline sessions, showing only reachable peers. Default false.

tool.name: Send
tool.description: Send a message to one peer session, to every reachable session, or to sessions in your project directory. Use it to hand off a result, claim a shared resource, flag a blocker, or ask a peer to stop. Do not use it for a sub-agent worker, and do not use it for running commentary. Returns the delivered count, the peer names, the envelope id and the skipped peers.

to.description: Recipient: a peer short id like "a1b2c3d4" or a full session id, or "all" to broadcast to every reachable peer, or "project" for peers in your project directory. Any prefix of a session id resolves. You cannot message yourself.

body.description: The message text. Keep it self-contained: the recipient has none of your context, so say who you are and what you need. Long coordination payloads are fine (safety ceiling ~256 KiB).

kind.description: Delivery kind. "message" (default) queues if busy, wakes if idle. "interrupt" signals urgency and changes the TUI glyph only, because the preemption hook is not built.

replyTo.description: Optional prior message id this replies to (threading, display-only).

tool.name: Inbox
tool.description: Re-read intercom messages that already arrived. Use it when you must review history, or to confirm that you already saw a message. Do not use it to wait for new mail: delivery is automatic on every turn. Returns message rows with sender id, model, timestamp and body, or an empty notice.

scope.description: "unread" (default) since your last Inbox read, or "recent" for the latest messages.
